neighbours.label: Enabling ' help' (also 'provide'): a thing helps bring about a beneficial effect, read at ' help' before a bare verb; quiet for help as a request or a noun
fire: Drinking enough water can help reduce headaches during hot weather.
Thicker curtains help keep the bedroom cool on summer afternoons.
A short walk after dinner may also help lower blood sugar.
Mulch around the stems will help retain moisture in sandy soil.
Reflective strips on a jacket help make cyclists visible at night.
Good ventilation can help protect the walls against damp and mould.
Eating slowly may help you feel full with smaller portions.
Strong passwords help safeguard your accounts against simple attacks.
quiet: He shouted for help when the ladder began to slip.
Could you help me move this table into the other room?
The help page lists every keyboard shortcut in the program.
She thanked the neighbours for their help during the hot weather.
Nobody came to help him, so he finished the fence alone.
With a little help from her brother she found the address.
Please help yourself to coffee and biscuits in the kitchen.
They hired extra help for the busy summer afternoons.

notes: Card flags the pole broad (1.1%). ' help' x8 of top 32, all 'X helps <verb> benefit'. Probe: 'help prevent' 0.38, 'help distribute' 0.52, 'provide a gentle way' 0.54; 'Can you help me' 0.006, 'for help' 0.02, 'help desk' 0.02.
